content: Simulate a moderately dense debris flow with shear-thinning non-Newtonian material. This is a 2D case. The boundary is a rectangle. A debris flow occupies the lower-left corner of this boundary, forming a 14.5 by 29.5 rectangular region with its shorter side along the bottom edge and its longer side running parallel to the left edge. The debris flow extends roughly two-thirds of the way up the boundary. Horizontally, the remaining 85 units of the boundary stretch from the right edge of the debris flow to the far-right wall.  Use debris density of 1700 kg/m^3, initial particle spacing dp = 0.5 m, use Symplectic step algorithm, artificial viscosity 0.1, output time interval 0.2s and run to total time 10s.

================================================================
  SIMULATION PLAN
================================================================

### Reasoning
This is a 2D rectangular dam-break-style debris-flow setup, so pointmin.y and pointmax.y are both 0 and all shapes span y=-1..1. From the geometry description, the fluid block is 14.5 wide by 29.5 high in the lower-left corner, and the remaining horizontal extent is 85, so total boundary width is 99.5. Since the debris reaches about two-thirds of the boundary height, I set the tank height to 30.0. I used a standard open-top rectangular boundary via boxfill faces with 3 layers, appropriate for coefh=1.0. For a moderately dense shear-thinning debris flow at 1700 kg/m^3, I matched rhop0 and phase_rhop to 1700, chose HBP_n=0.75 for shear-thinning, moderate consistency/yield values (visco_nn=0.15, tau_yield=0.02, HBP_m=20), and used the requested artificial viscosity 0.1, output interval 0.2 s, and total runtime 10 s. The requested Symplectic step algorithm is an execution setting outside the provided parameter schema, so it is not encoded here.

### Geometry XML
```xml
<geometry>
  <definition dp="0.5">
    <pointmin x="-1.0" y="0" z="-1.0" />
    <pointmax x="100.5" y="0" z="31.5" />
  </definition>
  <commands>
    <mainlist>
      <setshapemode>dp | bound</setshapemode>
      <setdrawmode mode="full" />
      <setmkfluid mk="0" />
      <drawbox>
        <boxfill>solid</boxfill>
        <point x="0" y="-1" z="0" />
        <size x="14.5" y="2" z="29.5" />
      </drawbox>
      <setmkbound mk="0" />
      <drawbox>
        <boxfill>bottom | left | right | front | back</boxfill>
        <point x="0" y="-1" z="0" />
        <size x="99.5" y="2" z="30.0" />
        <layers vdp="0,1,2" />
      </drawbox>
      <shapeout file="" />
    </mainlist>
  </commands>
</geometry>
```

### Physics Parameters
  gravity_z            = -9.81
  rhop0                = 1700.0
  coefh                = 1.0
  cflnumber            = 0.2
  phase_rhop           = 1700.0
  visco_nn             = 0.15
  tau_yield            = 0.02
  HBP_m                = 20.0
  HBP_n                = 0.75
  Visco                = 0.1
  DensityDT            = 3
  DensityDTvalue       = 0.1
  TimeMax              = 10.0
  TimeOut              = 0.2
